name: Paygent Connect
one_liner: Unresolved: no official Paygent Connect product, docs or API found. Candidates are Paygent (Japanese PSP, paygent.co.jp) and unrelated paygent.to; the NMI-powered US gateway could not be verified.
access_notes: No sign-up, credential or pricing page for Paygent Connect found. paygent.com and paygentconnect.com returned no content; docs.paygent.com unreachable. paygent.co.jp is a Japanese merchant payment gateway (ADAPTIS) with no public developer docs found.

buildability.rationale: Cannot identify the product or find any public API documentation. The only verifiable Paygent entity is the Japanese PSP, a merchant-contract gateway, which is likely not self-serve.

needs_human_reason: Confirm vendor and provide official developer docs URL for Paygent Connect; a web search returned nothing relevant and official domains returned empty pages.
